answers.core: It requires C++ code. The asset library is purely GDScript.
answers.workaround: I don't see how. The only way to add a shortcut to the list of shortcuts in EditorSettings is by using the setter for the "shortcuts" property. And, unfortunately, it only accepts InputEvents, which it turns into a shortcut object. The shortcut object is never returned, and lacks the "original" meta, which causes it to never appear in the options dialog. In other words, the closest thing to a workaround simply doesn't do the trick.

title: Provide GDScript access to `ED_SHORTCUT()` from editor_settings.cpp
